programmes.d: It's the end of the world as we know it in the first season finale as the conflict on the ground comes to a head and the situation on the Ark comes to a stunning conclusion.
In the season premiere, Clarke is still trapped, while the fate of Bellamy, Finn & Raven is still unknown. Meanwhile, the survivors of the Ark face a dangerous new world.
Clarke demands answers from President Wallace. Kane interrogates one of The 100, and Abby performs emergency surgery. Meanwhile, Octavia resorts to violence to find Lincoln.
When a woman with a rare disease inexplicably causes excruciating pain and subsequent death to those she encounters, the circumstances point to illegal drug trials… or worse.
When a strange parasite attaches itself to the internal organs of a dying agent, Agent Dunham rushes to Germany to meet with a prisoner who reveals details of a much larger threat.
When a music prodigy is kidnapped, it's discovered that a sequence of flashing lights appeared at the abduction — which Walter links back to his bunkmate at St. Claire's Hospital.
While investigating a mystifying incident at Massive Dynamic, Olivia seeks to rid her consciousness of Agent Scott and Peter's past catches up with him.
While investigating a series of extraordinary bank robberies that defy the laws of physics, Walter realizes that the high-tech thieves are after something of his.
After shifty FBI Agent Loeb orchestrated Mr. Jones's otherworldly escape from a German prison and Olivia's alarming abduction, indications of a larger threat begin to emerge.
Nothing is what it seems. When Clarke (ELIZA TAYLOR) discovers a horrifying project being carried out in Mount Weather's medical ward, she joins forces with an unlikely ally.
After being betrayed, Clarke takes matters into her own hands and proves she's not going down without a flight. Bellamy, Finn and Murphy race against time to save a stranger.
While Kane (HENRY IAN CUSICK) leads a mission to make peace with the Grounders, Lincoln (RICKY WHITTLE) enters a world of pain. And Finn's search for Clarke takes a violent turn.
Tensions run high between Clarke & Finn, while Octavia faces her worst nightmare. As Jasper & Monty discover the truth about Mt. Weather, Wallace is about to be betrayed.
Clarke comes up with a bold new plan to stop the Grounders' attack, leading Abby to a desperate decision. Meanwhile, Jasper & Monty question the motives of their new friends.
Clarke returns to Camp Jaha with devastating news. Finn struggles with the aftermath of his actions. Abby gathers information from an unlikely source and prepares for a fight.
Clarke strikes a deal with Lexa & Indra, while a seething Raven is unable to control her emotions. A move threatens to destroy the alliance between the Sky People & the Grounders.
Clarke and Lexa encounter a new enemy, while Bellamy and Lincoln team up to break into Mt. Weather. Meanwhile, Murphy helps Jaha confront his past, Indra makes Octavia an offer.
Bellamy and Lincoln's attempt to sneak into Mount Weather has brutal consequences, while Abby fights to stay in control as Clarke steps up in her new leadership role.
A computer scientist-turned-serial killer has discovered an unconventional method of killing people — by liquefying their brains.
When another mysterious virus emerges aboard an international flight, leaving freakish remains, Peter & Olivia are forced to go undercover to investigate the latest bizarre threat.
German agents question Olivia when Mr. Jones returns and a lethal toxin is released that causes victims to die without faces — as their orifices suddenly and mysteriously close up.
The FBI's Fringe Division investigates a mysterious, mute boy with an unspoken connection to Agent Olivia Dunham. Meanwhile, a gruesome serial killer resurfaces.
Unleashed by animal activists, a scientifically engineered beast with a ferocious appetite attacks Charlie. Walter must now come face-to-face with both his past and the creature.
The Pattern is given a thrilling twist when Agent Dunham can't stop dreaming of violent occurrences — that actually happen simultaneously in the real world.
Tensions between Clarke and Abby come to a head after Clarke crosses the line. Raven helps Bellamy navigate Mount Weather, where things reach a breaking point.
